summary: The StudentDemographics module provides an interface for managing student demographic data in HSPnet. It includes functionalities for editing and displaying student information via forms and controls.
purpose: To manage and update student demographic details including birthdate, ethnicity, and citizenship codes.

workflows.name: Update Student Demographics
steps: Retrieve student data based on UserSession and StudentID.
Enable editing if ScreenIsEditable is true.
Update the data source with new values.

business_rules: ScreenIsEditable determines if editing is allowed.
ReadOnly restricts visibility of edit options.
validations: Ensure UserSession is valid before processing.
DateFormatter is used to parse birthdate.
conditions: ScreenIsEditable must be true for the edit button to be visible.
If UserSession is null, cancel data retrieval.
system_behavior: Renders student information and controls dynamically.
Updates student information based on form submissions.
Redirects to Demographics page post update.
exceptions: Invalid UserSession leads to operation cancellation.
